about: Northeast Bank provides various banking services to individual and corporate customers in Maine. The company's deposit products include demand deposit, NOW, money market, savings, certificate of deposit, and checking accounts. Its loan portfolio comprises multi-family and other commercial real estate loans; residential and home equity loans; commercial and industrial loans, such as term loans, lines of credit and equipment, and receivables financing; and mobile home and overdraft, and deposit-secured loans. The company also provides telephone banking, online banking and bill payment, mobile banking, and remote deposit capture services, as well as debit and credit card, ATM, wire, electronic transfer, and check services; and engages in the investment activities. Northeast Bank was founded in 1872 and is headquartered in Portland, Maine.
